Dar Global Launches Trump Tower Jeddah

Dar Global PLC announced the launch of Trump Tower Jeddah, a landmark mixed-use development in the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

The project features luxury branded residences with views of the Red Sea coastline and will include premium amenities and services.

The development is part of DarGlobal's expanding portfolio in Saudi Arabia, with handover expected in Q4 2027.
